about: Where the Don's arms are, traced off guy.png (512x1024, the same frame as the rig, so rig px = texture px) from its silhouette runs and, where an arm is merged with the jacket or the scarf, from the seam line itself (a dark 1px stitch: x~180 beside the hanging arm down to y341, x=320 beside the cigar arm from y300 to y354; the cigar sleeve then borders the scarf's right strand, 320@360 -> 328@398). guy_feature.png and guy_don.png share this alpha exactly, so these hold for all three. Read by design/build_cast_guy_rig.py (--report, and it refuses to write a rig under own_floor) and by design/check_cast_motion.mjs rule 11. Belongs to the DRAWING: redraw the Don and these must be re-traced. Arm polygons contain only sleeve, cuff and hand: they stop at the seams, at the scarf, and at the fist's knuckles (the cigar's ash end and the smoke are left out). Both upper-arm polygons start where build_cast_guy_rig.py's shoulder fade-in ends (arc length reach_up x figure height = 0.10 x 799 = 80px below the shoulder joint: y322 hanging, y327 cigar), because above that the rig deliberately shares the shoulder with the spine. The upper/fore split is Capo's old report() boxes: y450 on the hanging arm, x350 on the cigar arm (the elbow crease). The spill strips are scarf beside each arm, which should stay on the spine; they are reported, not gated.
